rationale: The assistant reached the correct diagnosis of worn drum bearings efficiently, instructed the customer to unplug before the drum-play check, and correctly steered toward replacement rather than a DIY bearing swap. Weaknesses: it never asked make, model or age (so the replace-vs-repair verdict was given without knowing the machine was ~9 years and £350), added an unsupported 'likely the spider arm' claim, and stated 'it is almost never worth fixing' without offering the option of an engineer quote. Still, a UK homeowner would be well served by the outcome.
